products.name: Neo Genesis Booster Box
products.priceSource: TCGplayer price history, Unopened market price $14,000 (3-day buckets 2026-09-14 to 2026-09-29, no sales in the window; tcgcsv lists no market price). Thin: 36 packs at the $632.32 pack price would be $22,763.52.
products.note: Unlimited box, 36 packs of 11 cards (TCGplayer 193335, Elite Fourum, PSA 9409). The 1st Edition box (193334) is not built.

products.name: Theme Deck "Cold Fusion"
products.note: A 60-card Lightning and Water deck with a holo Kingdra (Neo Genesis 8), the deck's featured card, plus a metal Lugia coin and markers (not simulated). List: Bulbapedia 'Cold Fusion (TCG)' and PokeBeach's Neo Genesis theme-deck page. TCGplayer has no market price for it: the shop price is its mid listing price ($437.50; low $375.00, high $499.99, 2 listings on 2026-10-01).

products.name: Theme Deck "Hotfoot"
products.note: A 60-card Neo Genesis theme deck, featuring Jumpluff (Neo Genesis 7); metal Lugia coin + markers. Not simulated: coin and markers. List: Bulbapedia deck page and PokeBeach's Neo Genesis theme-deck page (they differ by a card in places).
products.priceSource: No TCGplayer price for the sealed deck: the sum of its 60 cards at the site's card prices (TCGplayer market, Unlimited). A sealed deck sells for more.
